intent: A sports commentator opening on a date, like a documentary: in 1896… Then quick, then the reveal with a grin, then three facts that make people say “really?”.
pacing_profile: date-led story hook over a slow Mediterranean drift, three quick options, a 3-s beat, a warm reveal, three see-it beats, CTA and loop
pause_policy: Pause only at the marked ellipses; the beat is real silence (ticks come from quizscore.py).

lines.text: April, 1896. The Games are back after fifteen centuries. Where?

lines.direction: quick, each option its own beat

lines.text: Athens. The first modern Olympics, in a stadium built entirely of marble.
Two hundred and forty one athletes, fourteen nations, and not a single woman.
Winners got silver, not gold. Gold only arrived in 1904.

lines.direction: close the loop on the wrong answers
lines.text: Paris hosted next in 1900, then London in 1908.

title: Where were the FIRST modern Olympics held?
